thread:
tom: quick note — noticed the Ruby quickstart still uses REDWOOD_API_TOKEN while Go & JS use REDWOOD_API_KEY. Causing onboarding 401s. Copy/paste reports from support.

nina: thanks for flagging. reproduction: export REDWOOD_API_TOKEN=sk-... then run ruby sample -> header missing.

leo: also the Ruby sample has `API_KEY = "sk-test-xxxxx"` inline which is a security footgun. we should switch to ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'] and remove placeholders.

nina: agreed. i'll make a tiny PR to standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY across languages, replace literals, and add a short troubleshooting blurb: "If you see repeated 401s, check env var name and ensure no smart quotes from copy/paste."

leo: can we also change the SDK retry note in the quickstart? right now it says "retries are instant" which is wrong; SDK uses exp backoff so users sometimes think it's frozen.

tom: yes, add one-liner: "The SDK will retry with exponential backoff; repeated 401s may appear as slow/blocked requests while backoff runs." Link to SDK retry docs.

docs-bot: created DOC-999: "quickstart env var parity + remove inline keys" and added checklist.

ci-bot: suggested CI check: docs pipeline grep for `REDWOOD_API_(KEY|TOKEN)` usage and a secret regex for `sk-[A-Za-z0-9\-]{8,}`. Will add a docs-only job to fail on literal keys.

nina: PR incoming. please run a quick Windows powershell smoke test for the curl example; powershell users keep tripping on quoting.

leo: i'll run it. Also add a tiny note in the README to avoid copy/pasting example keys and to show how to set env vars in bash/pwsh.

tom: sweet — this should cut down the onboarding tickets. thanks! :raised_hands:
_meta: generated devex thread - sdk snippet parity and auth env var consistency
